about.heading: WE ARE AVAILABLE FOR
about.paragraph: With 14 years of combined experience, we specialize in building custom web solutions for businesses and entrepreneurs. From WordPress to Vue.js, Angular, .NET, Drupal, and PrestaShop, we deliver websites and applications that help our clients succeed online.

project1.title: Pizza Fina
project1.subtitle: WordPress & Angular
project1.description: The website pizzafina.ca is an online platform for PizzaFina, a food service offering a range of menu items including pizzas, specials, chicken wings, sides, poutines, sandwiches, salads, fries, and beverages. Customers can place orders online for home delivery.

project2.title: SGE & IGE
project2.subtitle: Wordpress
project2.description: The website https://sgeieg.fr/ focuses on the professional branch of the Electrical and Gas Industries (IEG) in France. It represents companies involved in the production, transportation, distribution, commercialization, and supply of electricity and gas whose personnel are governed by the national status of IEG staff under French law.

project3.title: SOC Hockey
project3.subtitle: Wordpress & VueJS
project3.description: The website https://www.hockey-chambery.com/ is the official site for the Hockey Club of Chambéry, known as "Les Éléphants de Chambéry." It features club news, player information, photo albums, rankings for their Division 1 team, ticketing details, partners, and a club shop.

project4.title: Najen nature
project4.subtitle: Prestashop
project4.description: The website https://najen-nature.com/ is focused on natural and organic products, offering a range of eco-friendly, health-oriented items. It emphasizes sustainable and natural living choices through products and services.
